mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cat_traits( cat_id, personality, activity_level, affection_level, child_friendly, pet_friendly, shedding_level, nocturnal, space_need_level, beginner_friendly, special_care_needed, environment_preference, update_time ) VALUES ( #{catId}, #{personality}, #{activityLevel}, #{affectionLevel}, #{childFriendly}, #{petFriendly}, #{sheddingLevel}, #{nocturnal}, #{spaceNeedLevel}, #{beginnerFriendly}, #{specialCareNeeded}, #{environmentPreference}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE personality = VALUES(personality), activity_level = VALUES(activity_level), affection_level = VALUES(affection_level), child_friendly = VALUES(child_friendly), pet_friendly = VALUES(pet_friendly), shedding_level = VALUES(shedding_level), nocturnal = VALUES(nocturnal), space_need_level = VALUES(space_need_level), beginner_friendly = VALUES(beginner_friendly), special_care_needed = VALUES(special_care_needed), environment_preference = VALUES(environment_preference), update_time = NOW()
